title: Practice 3: Every day, all week, on Saturdays

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Снег пролежал всего ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The snow was there for just an hour.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Только по ___ (вторники) сюда и ходит….
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Антон Чехов, «Сапоги».

exercises.q: Он приехал во ___ (вторник).
exercises.why: «во» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I've been sitting here all night.
exercises.why: «целый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Максим Горький, «Жизнь Клима Самгина»*
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Клима Самгина».

exercises.q: He earns half a million yen a month.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Чистота воды проверяется ___ (каждый час).
exercises.prompt: The purity of the water is checked every hour.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Это началось у меня еще по ___ (шестнадцатый год).
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Подросток».

exercises.q: Что ты делал в ___ (праздники)?
exercises.prompt: What did you do during the holidays?
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The bed linen changes every week.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Максим Горький, «Жизнь Матвея Кожемякина»*
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Матвея Кожемякина».

exercises.q: The rain water is evaporating on a hot day.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: ___ (каждая весна) река здесь разливается.
exercises.prompt: Every spring the river floods here.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (среды) бывали вечеринки.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Антон Чехов, «Попрыгунья».

exercises.q: Он приходит в ___ (полдень).
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: After only a year her breast implants started to leak and she had to have them removed.
exercises.ru: Всего ___ спустя её грудные импланты потекли, и ей пришлось их удалить.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Денис Фонвизин, «Недоросль»*
exercises.ru: Мой Митрофанушка из-за книги не встает по ___.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Денис Фонвизин, «Недоросль».

exercises.q: Will you be here on Wednesday?
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (каждый понедельник) встаёт рано и идёт в парк, чтобы помедитировать.
exercises.prompt: Tom gets up early every Monday and goes to the park to meditate.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (зимы) он ездит в Петербург.
exercises.why: «по» + dative. From Иван Тургенев, «Записки охотника».
